commands.review_summary:
The PR caps Codex native subagent completion delivery retries at the configured delay schedule, marks exhausted delivery failed, skips periodic reconciliation while a retry timer is armed, and adds monitor regression tests.

PR surface: Source +28, Tests +229. Total +257 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main and v2026.6.11 are source-reproducible: non-durable completion delivery marks pending and re-arms with a clamped delay index but no maximum attempt or deadline; I did not run a live channel outage in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(codex): cap native subagent completion delivery retries
target.body:
## Summary

**Problem**: Codex native subagent completion delivery retries indefinitely on permanently non-durable parent handoffs (silent subagent in `message_tool_only` session), waking the parent agent forever. Two paths contribute: (1) `scheduleCompletionDeliveryRetry` re-arms with no cap; (2) `reconcileKnownTaskRowsForParent` can call `deliverPendingCompletion` while a retry timer is armed, bypassing the timer path's cap.

**Solution**: (1) Cap timer-path retries at the schedule length — mark delivery `failed` on exhaustion; (2) Guard reconciler to skip `processCompletion` when `completionDeliveryTimer` is armed, so the bounded timer path handles delivery exclusively.

**What changed**: `native-subagent-monitor.ts`: +28 (retry cap + reconciler guard). `native-subagent-monitor.test.ts`: +229 (3 regression tests: fake-timer cap, real-timer cap, reconciler guard).

**What did NOT change**: Retry-delay schedule config (`completionDeliveryRetryDelaysMs`). Schedule length is the implicit cap — no new config.

Fixes #97593

## What Problem This Solves

Non-durable parent handoffs cause the Codex native subagent monitor to retry delivery forever, repeatedly waking the parent agent. The retry loop has two entry points: the timer path and the reconciler path — both need bounding.

## Root Cause

1. `native-subagent-monitor.ts:617` — main increments `completionDeliveryAttempt` but never compares to schedule length
2. `native-subagent-monitor.ts:949` — reconciler calls `processCompletion` with no guard for active `completionDeliveryTimer`

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Codex native subagent monitor retries delivery indefinitely via both timer and reconciler paths.

**Real environment tested**: Node 24.13.1, Linux x86_64. Full `CodexNativeSubagentMonitor` test suite exercising timer and reconciler codepaths with real transcript loading and mocked Codex client.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**: `pnpm test extensions/codex/src/app-server/native-subagent-monitor.test.ts`

**After-fix evidence**:
```
pnpm test extensions/codex/src/app-server/native-subagent-monitor.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8  |  Node 24.13.1  |  Linux x86_64

 ✓ stops retrying after exhausting the retry schedule (#97593) 29ms
 ✓ stops retrying with real timers — no fake-timer dependency (#97593) 807ms
 ✓ skips reconciler delivery while a completion retry timer is armed (#97593) 7ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  36 passed (36)
```

**Observed result after the fix**: (1) Timer cap: with [10ms, 20ms] schedule, delivery called exactly 3 times (1 initial + 2 retries), then stops — status marked `failed`. (2) Reconciler guard: reconciler run at t=15ms while timer armed at t=30ms — delivery count unchanged; timer fires on schedule, exhausts cap normally. (3) Real timers: verified with actual `setTimeout` — retries fire with real delays, stop on exhaustion.

**What was not tested**: Live Codex app-server with real non-durable handoffs. No Codex runtime available. The 3 targeted tests exercise the exact codepaths (timer cap, reconciler bypass guard, real-timer exhaustion) with full monitor lifecycle, mocked Codex client, and transcript file loading.

**Evidence provenance**: `pnpm test` on PR head at Node 24.13 / Linux x86_64, 2026-07-02.

## Evidence

### Timer cap — fake timers

[10ms, 20ms] schedule → 3 calls (1 initial + 2 retries) → `setDetachedTaskDeliveryStatusByRunId` called with `failed` → no more calls after 1000ms

### Timer cap — real timers

Actual `setTimeout` callbacks — proves the fix works without depending on fake-timer infrastructure

### Reconciler guard — armed timer (new)

Reconciler called with armed timer → guard skips `processCompletion` → delivery count unchanged → timer fires on schedule → exhausts cap → marks failed

### Full suite

```
36/36 passed, zero regressions
```

## Design Decisions

**Why schedule-length cap instead of separate config?** The schedule already encodes bounded policy. A separate `maxAttempts` would create two sources of truth. Schedule-length-as-cap keeps the policy surface minimal.

**Why guard reconciler rather than remove it?** Reconciler is needed for new transcript-discovered completions. Only skip when a timer already handles delivery.

## ClawSweeper Feedback Addressed

| Review | Issue | Resolution |
|--------|-------|------------|
| 2026-06-30 P2 | Reconciler bypasses retry cap (monitor.ts:641) | Guard: skip `processCompletion` when `completionDeliveryTimer` is armed. Focused regression test verifies no bypass. |

## Risk checklist

**Highest-risk area**: Reconciler discovers new completion while retry timer is armed for a different completion. `completionDeliveryTimer` is set/cleared atomically — a new completion won't collide.

**Risk level**: Low — additive skip guard. Timer path handles delivery on schedule. 36/36 tests pass.

**Merge risk declaration**: No merge risk. Single Codex plugin file. No lockfile/changelog changes.

## Linked context

| Issue/PR | Status | Relationship |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| #97593 | Open | Canonical tracker |
| #97594 | Open | Same-root sibling, different cap approach |
| #97715 | Open | Same-root sibling, screenshot proof |
